mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.user_id AS userId, f.job_id AS jobId, f.created_at AS createdAt, j.id AS job_id, j.title AS job_title, j.department_id AS job_departmentId, j.location AS job_location, j.salary_min AS job_salaryMin, j.salary_max AS job_salaryMax, j.salary_display AS job_salaryDisplay, j.education AS job_education, j.experience AS job_experience, j.headcount AS job_headcount, j.description AS job_description, j.requirements AS job_requirements, j.benefits AS job_benefits, j.status AS job_status, j.view_count AS job_viewCount, j.apply_count AS job_applyCount, j.is_hot AS job_isHot, j.created_at AS job_createdAt, j.updated_at AS job_updatedAt FROM favorites f LEFT JOIN jobs j ON f.job_id = j.id AND j.is_delete = 0 WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.is_delete = 0 ORDER BY f.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
